name: HVE Core Adoption Check
description: Paste it into GitHub Copilot Chat on a repository and it reports which HVE Core agents and instruction files fit the repository's languages, where HVE's instructions would contradict or duplicate its existing copilot-instructions.md, and which install route (Marketplace extensions, Copilot CLI plugin or a selective clone) avoids the clashes.
author: Arindam Choudhury
